description: Convert a JSON object, array, JSON string, JSON Lines (NDJSON) or base64 JSON file into clean, validated XML 1.0. Supports custom root and array item tags, automatic plural-to-singular array element names (orders -> order), @attr to XML attributes and #text content, xsi:nil or omit null handling, XML tag sanitization, and pretty-print or minified output. Deterministic (lxml), 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/json-to-xml.

itemName.description: Fallback element name for array items

json.description: JSON object, array, or JSON/JSONL string to convert (empty = built-in sample order catalog)

nullMode.description: Null handling: self-closing tag, xsi:nil='true', or omit

parseAttributes.description: Map @key fields to XML attributes and #text to element text

rootName.description: Root XML element name when needed

smartArrayNames.description: Singularize plural parent keys for array items (orders -> order)

unwrapSingleRoot.description: Use a single top-level JSON key as the root element

name: json_to_xml
title: JSON to XML API - convert JSON or JSONL into validated XML 1.0
